name: Diana Taurasi
record_line: Hall page: retired as the WNBA's all-time leading scorer with 10,646 points (2004-2024). Three WNBA titles with the Mercury (2007, 2009, 2014). Finals MVP in 2009 and 2014. MVP in 2009. Rookie of the Year in 2004. 11 All-Star teams.

name: Sandy Brondello
teams: Phoenix Mercury; New York Liberty; Toronto Tempo
record_line: Hall page: WNBA champion as Mercury head coach in 2014 and as Liberty head coach in 2024. Coach of the Year in 2014. First head coach of the Toronto Tempo (2025). WNBA.com Coach of the Year list, Sept. 28, 2026: Sandy Brondello, Phoenix, 2014.

name: Mike Thibault
record_line: Hall page: Sun head coach 2003-2012. Mystics head coach 2013-2022. Led the Mystics to their first WNBA title in 2019. Retired as the WNBA's all-time winningest coach at 379-289. Coach of the Year in 2006, 2008 and 2013. WNBA.com, Sept. 28, 2026: Cheryl Reeve became the regular-season wins leader with her 380th win on July 8, 2026, and finished the regular season with 397. The same release lists Thibault in 2006, 2008 and 2013.
